prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” Miami personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the specifics of your crash, injuries, insurance limits and whether the case will likely settle or go to trial. I can help you find top options, but first here’s how to pick the best lawyer for your situation and what I’ll need to find tailored recommendations.

Quick checklist of what matters
- Relevant experience: handled car-accident cases with injuries similar to yours (soft-tissue vs. fractured bones vs. catastrophic injury).
- Trial experience and resources: important if the insurer denies liability or offers a low settlement.
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts, client reviews.
- Fee structure: most Florida PI attorneys work on contingency (commonly 33%–40% of recovery plus costs).
- Communication and availability: responsiveness, language needs (Spanish), and a team that will manage medical liens and bills.
- Licensing & discipline: clear record with the Florida Bar; ideal if Board-Certified in Civil Trial Law.
- Local knowledge: familiarity with Miami-Dade courts, judges and local medical providers.

Important practical points
- Florida statute of limitations for personal injury is generally 4 years from the crash; wrongful-death claims are usually 2 years. Don’t wait to consult a lawyer.
- Ask whether they advance case costs (medical records, expert fees) and how those are repaid.
- Look for a free initial consultation and when they would file suit if needed.

Questions to ask at a consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the outcomes?
- Do you try cases or mostly settle?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your fee and are there additional costs?
- Can you provide references or examples of past settlements/verdicts?
- Do you have experience with my insurer/opposing counsel?

How I can help next
If you want, tell me:
- ZIP code in Miami
- Date of accident
- Type/severity of injuries
- Whether fault is disputed and any insurer details
- Any language preferences

I’ll then give a short, vetted list of well-rated Miami personal injury lawyers who match your needs (plus links to profiles, ratings and items to check). Would you like me to do that?
